# FLX-4004: cumulative token spend exceeds the effective budget across calls

**Family:** governance/sovereignty (the 4000 band)

flux_engine.governance.gate.AIGate tracks tokens actually spent per (policyDigest, skillRef) across every call made through one instance. RFC-04's decide() enforces the budget per call; this is the budget enforced across calls -- a policy that allows N tokens does not allow the same allowed call an unlimited number of times.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-4004
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
